spell.openworld_rpg.arc_bolt.name: Arc Bolt
spell.openworld_rpg.arc_bolt.description: Launches a focused arcane bolt at the aimed enemy.
spell.openworld_rpg.phase_step.name: Phase Step
spell.openworld_rpg.phase_step.descripti: Blink forward along a safe path. A completed Arcane Weave leaves a slowing arcane field at the origin.
spell.openworld_rpg.frost_ring.name: Frost Ring
spell.openworld_rpg.frost_ring.descripti: Burst frost around yourself, damaging and Chilling nearby enemies. A completed Arcane Weave grants you a barrier.
spell.openworld_rpg.flame_burst.name: Flame Burst
spell.openworld_rpg.flame_burst.descript: Ignite a targeted patch of ground, repeatedly damaging enemies and applying Burning. Arcane Weave intensifies both the burst and Burning.
spell.openworld_rpg.astral_convergence.d: Collapse arcane force around yourself in repeated waves, drawing susceptible enemies inward before the final detonation. Arcane Weave empowers the detonation.
spell.openworld_rpg.radiant_lance.name: Radiant Lance
spell.openworld_rpg.radiant_lance.descri: Hurls a radiant lance at an enemy. Full Grace empowers its follow-up effect.
spell.openworld_rpg.mend.name: Mend
spell.openworld_rpg.mend.description: Restores health to the aimed ally or yourself.
spell.openworld_rpg.rebuke.name: Rebuke
spell.openworld_rpg.rebuke.description: Unleashes a frontal holy burst that damages, staggers, and weakens enemy direct damage.
spell.openworld_rpg.sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
spell.openworld_rpg.sanctuary.descriptio: Raises a holy ward that shields allies, restores health, and scorches enemies within its boundary.
spell.openworld_rpg.warrior_driving_slas: Drive forward with a heavy slash. Full Momentum empowers the strike.
spell.openworld_rpg.warrior_iron_counter: Brace briefly and counter the first valid committed melee hit.
Spin through two visible cuts around you. Full Momentum empowers the second hit.
spell.openworld_rpg.warrior_breaker_slam: Commit to a poise-heavy frontal slam with temporary hyperarmor.
spell.openworld_rpg.warrior_earthshatter: Rupture the ground ahead with overwhelming damage and poise pressure.
spell.openworld_rpg.consecrated_ground.d: Consecrate the ground around you, restoring allies and damaging enemies within the field.
spell.openworld_rpg.hunter_quickstep_vol: Dash with your movement and loose three arrows. Full Focus lengthens the step and lets each arrow pierce one normal enemy.
Fire a heavy arrow that snares its target. Full Focus extends the snare and increases poise pressure.
spell.openworld_rpg.hunter_fan_of_arrows: Loose five arrows in a readable cone. Full Focus fires seven in a wider fan while keeping the same target hit cap.
spell.openworld_rpg.hunter_power_shot.de: Commit to a heavy draw, then loose a high-speed arrow. Authored weak points amplify the hit; full Focus strengthens both the shot and its weak-point multiplier.
spell.openworld_rpg.hunter_skyfall.name: Skyfall
spell.openworld_rpg.hunter_skyfall.descr: Mark the ground for a sustained arrow storm. Enemies remaining in the exposed field are slowed and take repeated physical and poise pressure.
spell.openworld_rpg.guardian_bulwark_rus: Drive forward behind your guard, reducing frontal guardable damage during the rush and crashing into the first enemy.
spell.openworld_rpg.guardian_warding_str: Sweep a guarded arc that damages enemies and Provokes AI-controlled targets toward you.
spell.openworld_rpg.guardian_aegis_field: Consume all Resolve to shield yourself and nearby allies. Each Resolve pip strengthens the barrier.
spell.openworld_rpg.guardian_counterwall: Brace briefly. The first valid perfect-guardable hit is denied and answered by a heavy frontal counter wave.
spell.openworld_rpg.guardian_unbroken_li: Raise a moving defensive line around you, shielding allies and reinforcing damage resistance, guard efficiency, and your poise.
